final: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT powerstatus, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY powerstatus), shares AS (SELECT telescope_count, 1.0 * telescope_count / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share FROM status_counts), above_average AS (SELECT telescope_count, share FROM shares WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares)) SELECT SUM(telescope_count) AS total_telescope_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares)) AS average_excess_share FROM above_average
